activity_summary: Last, you said the letter was still on the board and that you had named no one to take it. You were not opening the coffer, and you were not counting. The cat had been moved. You stopped.

facets.activity: Ended the night with the letter on the board

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The sheet is still on the board.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A difference is not a sum until it is counted, and I am not counting.
